title: Isometric Chunk
description: This mod adds a new isometric chunkminimap to the HUD in both a 3x3 or 1x1 chunk. There is an also option to view the whole map of chunks you have explored in an isometric view.
body:
# Introducing the Isometric Chunk Mod

A new isometric view of your world!

This mod contains:
- A 1x1 isometric HUD view of the chunk you are currently in.
- A 3x3 isometric HUD 'full' view of the chunks you are currently in.
- A 3x3 isometric HUD 'explore' view of the chunks you are currently in.
- A full isometric map of the chunks you have explored, with height / depth scrolling.
- A full config window to control how your isometric chunk view appears.

## 1x1 isometric HUD view

![Image shows a 1x1 chunk of a village house](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/548e76c4b021e797b3e09e44ab81acc75e311273.png)

## 3x3 isometric HUD 'full' view

![Image showing a 3x3 isometric HUD view of a village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e04c8549f1a1f09f6b742f86763e70e2ffea3c9.png)

## 3x3 isometric HUD 'explore' view

![Image shows a not fully explored 3x3 isometric view of a village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8d551359a07994748f9e88b0204cf133663056b.png)

## Isometric Map View

![Image shows full isometric map view of explored chunks with indicators for; "Scroll: depth", "Drag: pan", "arrow keys: Rotate", "plus / minus keys: zoom", "Escape: Zoom"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c95fbebf16962c1301137d952564f260008aa20.png)

## Config Screen

This screen is accessed via Mods > Isometric Chunk.

![Image shows the config options for the isometric chunk mod. There are 6 options; "Enabled", "Brightness", "Scale, "Screen Corner", "Map Size", "Cache Refresh"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5fe646a32cf9e7e0645b910ddb96dadb01f75482_0.webp)
